body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #3, company drawn at random from the cheapest EV/EBITDA tercile (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.62 (naive base rate 0.4) that: Automotive Axles FY27 revenue from operations is >= Rs 2,500 cr. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 Rs 1,179 cr (+24%); needs H2 >= Rs 1,321 cr (+7.7% vs H2 FY26 Rs 1,226 cr, about 2x the Q2 run-rate of Rs 663 cr); pre-buy to April 2027; Q4 is seasonally strongest. Naive base: 4 of 10 fiscal years FY17-FY26 had revenue growth >= 14.8% (FY18, FY19, FY22, FY23) [SCR]. Resolution: YES if revenue from operations for FY27 (1-Apr-2026 to 31-Mar-2027), as first reported in the audited FY27 results, is >= Rs 2,500 cr. Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (results) + screener.in (standalone; AAL has no subsidiaries). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
